---
title: Lists of floats
author: Test Author
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: With typst-extras list-of, a mcanouil report opens its body with a list of figures and a list of tables, each entry a caption.
        check: bash _checks/extras.sh list-of
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#typst-extras-list-of\(']
---
